acceptanceCriteria: Multi-line parenthesised from-imports resolve all names.
A test fails without the fix.
body: Residual of lane PR beamfall/corvint#1469 (affected-1021n, seal 6c411fe85, base ef2a01db5). Expected: `from pkg import (\n a,\n b)` resolves a and b like the one-line form. Actual: names after the first line are not parsed, so submodule edges are missed.
